title: ÆTHER: First Love v17 (Tamil lyrics by Mr. Kavi, romanised lines)
story: A boy sees a girl for the first time and falls in love, told by ONE love melody that is first hummed, then sung in Tamil, and grows into a celebration.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 10:11 on v16 (Malayalam): 'I don't know about Malayalam, let's try Tamil'. v17 = the same v2.5 chunk plan, form, key and tempo as v16 with Mr. Kavi's Tamil lyrics; lyric sheet /mnt/project-files/music/first-love-v17/first-love-v17-lyrics.md. v17 has Tamil script, v17r the same lines romanised.

positive_styles: one single South Indian style love song built on ONE memorable love melody that returns again and again
bright G major the whole way with the magical raised fourth of raga Kalyani
one steady 92 BPM pulse from start to end

one soft sweet close female voice singing the words in Tamil (the lines are Tamil written in English letters), clear natural diction, gamakam slides and a long held note that bends at the end of each line
soft wordless female humming between the sung lines
bansuri flute, violin section in Indian-style unison, plucked veena, felt piano, acoustic guitar, deep warm round bass, tabla and dholak keherwa groove with a soft kick and claps
all instruments close, dry and natural, played by real musicians
the female voice hums the love melody softly
light tabla pulse and veena
curious and wondering
